payload.name: Exact-Date Fallback Search for Missed Activity Memories
payload.description: Use when a question asks what someone played, watched, or did on an exact calendar date and the first searches return only thematically related memories without that date; before answering, run one structured search filtered by person and exact date.
content: If the question includes an exact calendar date for a person's activity and the initial hybrid/keyword searches return only undated or topically related memories, run one additional search_memory that filters on the person's name and that exact date (world_start on that day), keeping the query text to just the person and the activity verb.

Inspect the returned memories whose world_start matches that date even when their wording differs from the question (e.g., uses media titles, 'immersive', or 'recommendations' instead of descriptors like 'futuristic setting' or 'gameplay').

Stop after this single date-scoped fallback: if it still yields no direct evidence, answer from the best available visible evidence or state insufficiency; do not enumerate all memories for the date or broaden into exhaustive searching.

solves: Text-only retrieval misses a memory when a user asks about someone's activity on an exact calendar date and the supporting memory stores that date only in metadata while describing the item with different vocabulary than the question. This Skill applies to future person+exact-date+activity questions whose first searches return only undated or topically related memories; it must not apply to date-less preference questions or when direct date-matched evidence already appears.
